calculation.description: Subtract equal-weight universe daily return from each asset return, form a 20-session relative trend, divide by 30-session annualized relative volatility plus a cross-sectional volatility floor, and scale by the lagged market breadth regime. All signal inputs are lagged one completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark-wide absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily paper ICIR >= 0.0840 across the 15-asset universe. Long-window recent stability is negative: 365-session IC -0.02608/ICIR -1.3259, 750-session IC -0.03025/ICIR -1.6458, 1260-session IC -0.03249/ICIR -1.8110; use conservatively and monitor drift. At least 8 valid instruments per date; almost all dates had all 15.
